formulas: Equation 3 defines intra-place diversity IPD_i as the average L2 distance between each image descriptor in place P_i and the mean descriptor of that place.
Equations 4-5 define cosine similarity between place prototypes and IPS_i as the average similarity to the k nearest places within the current selection mini-batch.
Equation 6 min-max normalizes IPD and IPS inside each mini-batch and forms Score_i = alpha times normalized IPD_i plus (1-alpha) times normalized IPS_i.

The paper supplies no theorem that its alpha-weighted score estimates replay utility; alpha, B, and k are empirical hyperparameters and the Stage1 contract must not combine Q/R/A/D by this weighted-score pattern.
algorithm_steps: Use a fixed pretrained VPR proxy to extract image descriptors once, then average descriptors within every place.
Partition the ordered place list into sequential selection mini-batches of at most B places without clustering or stochastic sampling.
Within each mini-batch, compute IPD for positive-pair variation and IPS against k neighboring place prototypes for hard-negative potential.
Min-max normalize the two signals, combine them with alpha, remove the requested lowest-scoring fraction, and union retained places across mini-batches.
Freeze the resulting place identities, train the final VPR model on all images belonging to retained places, and evaluate retrieval Recall at fixed pruning ratios.
variables: place P_i, K_i images per place, image descriptors f_j^i, and mean place descriptor f-bar_i
intra-place diversity IPD_i and inter-place similarity IPS_i
nearest-place count k, selection mini-batch capacity B, and balancing coefficient alpha
pruning ratio r = 1 - M/N with N candidate places and M retained places
proxy model, final VPR backbone and aggregator, training time, selection time, and Recall at K
selection_timing: Selection is performed once before final-model training using a fixed pretrained proxy; it is not conditioned on the evolving final-model checkpoint.
refresh_rule: The coreset is frozen for a reported training run and may be reused across final VPR architectures; no epoch-level refresh or lagged online selector is defined.

budget.unit: unique place identities, with all images of each retained place kept as a relational group
budget.denominator: all places in GSV-Cities or in the merged multi-dataset training pool before pruning
budget.unique_sample_definition: The selected set is unique at the place level, but place sizes differ and the paper does not publish a normalized image-count or optimizer-visible-example ledger.
budget.repeat_definition: Retained images are revisited through ordinary training epochs; per-place and per-image repeat histograms are not reported.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: Pruning ratio fixes retained places rather than cumulative optimizer-visible exposure; early stopping changes epochs and steps, so method, random, and full-data runs are not exposure matched.
budget.compute_cost: Reported selection time excludes the shared initial descriptor extraction in several comparisons; end-to-end tables separately include the one-time extraction and selection overhead, while descriptor storage remains an explicit limitation.

This makes MSLS-val a model-study split rather than independent confirmation evidence; seed-wise final-checkpoint outcomes are not reported.

negative_results: Average R@1 drops below the full-data baseline at 50% and 70% pruning despite favorable results on several individual datasets.
At 99% pruning every compared selector degrades, with larger loss on the domain-shifted Nordland set.
The alpha, B, and k sweeps are non-monotonic and are configured differently across pruning ratios.
Selection-time plots omit initial descriptor extraction, and full end-to-end savings are smaller after this shared cost is included.
Uniform random is matched only on nominal place ratio, not on images, optimizer steps, early-stopping epochs, training seed, source strata, or cumulative exposure.
failure_conditions: Sequential mini-batches omit globally nearest places or normalize scores inconsistently across batches.
A proxy descriptor emphasizes the wrong domain, causing rare or target-relevant places to receive low scores.
Extremely small budgets remove scene rarity and domain coverage even when average within-domain redundancy is high.
Alpha-tuned IPD/IPS weighting hides a reversal that would appear when the two mechanisms are tested separately.
Early stopping and evaluation reuse MSLS-val, or unreported training seeds hide a worst-seed loss against random.
limitations: This is a one-shot pretraining coreset study, not additive replay over a fixed base-training trajectory.
The method uses an arbitrary alpha-weighted combination; Stage1 forbids collapsing Q/R/A/D into such a total score.
Nominal place ratios do not match unique image IDs, repeats, cumulative exposure, optimizer-visible steps, or early-stopping duration.
No training-seed count, paired seed result, variance, or worst-seed outcome is reported.
MSLS-val is used both for early stopping and as a reported benchmark column, so it is not an independent confirmation split.
Targets are retrieval Recall metrics rather than an independent FN=0..95 safety frontier and two-ended operational constraints.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 该文直接支持把来源或 place 作为 D 的集合单位，并把组内条件变化、近邻来源相似性、稀有场景覆盖和同预算 random 作为可分开的析因条件。Stage1 可迁移其分组保留、覆盖失败检查和随机对照思路，但 Q、R、A、D 必须顺序门控或析因，不能复制 alpha 加权总分。
stage1_non_inference_zh: 论文的 VPR coreset 结果不能证明 replay utility：选择发生在训练前、基础训练流和累计 replay 曝光未固定、optimizer steps 与 early-stop 时长未匹配、没有 R1/R2/current-loss/no-replay 配对、没有独立 FN95 目标，也没有未见 training seed 的最差情形。
